notes: The source calls these runes Marks. This export uses the user-facing category names requested for calculator import.
Normal categories use category-level baseCostPerOpen; there is no per-rollable purchase cost in source.
baseCumulativeChanceAtLuck1 is min(1, 1 / cumulativeDenominator) for tier 2+ and 1 for tier 1.
baseExclusiveDropChanceAtLuck1 is computed with NormalMarkCommon.BuildTierProbabilities at MarkLuck = 1.
At exactly x1 MarkLuck, the UI displays rarityText instead of the computed exclusive chance.
effectCaps cap copies used for that specific effect, not inventory ownership.
effectCurves replace linear per-copy effect math for the listed effect keys.
Hidden or isSecret rollables are still in the same normal roll table; no extra unlock requirement is defined in MarkConfig or the button runtime.
Time estimates below assume enough currency to pay baseCostPerOpen for every open; the runtime still gates by affordability.

formulas.thresholdChance: threshold[i] = clamp(MarkLuck / cumulativeDenominator[i], 0, 1) for tiers i >= 2
formulas.exclusiveTierProbability: p[1] = 1 - threshold[2]; p[i] = threshold[i] - threshold[i+1] for middle tiers; p[last] = threshold[last]; then normalize if needed
formulas.cloneApplication: Roll base opens first, then multiply gained copies by MarkClone.
formulas.expectedSecondsForFirstBaseDrop: 1 / (marksPerSecond * exclusiveTierProbability), assuming enough currency and MarkLuck enabled
formulas.expectedSecondsForTargetCopies: targetCopies / (marksPerSecond * exclusiveTierProbability * MarkClone), approximation after clone amplification
formulas.globalWeightedChance: weight / sum(weights); MarkLuck is not applied to global marks

unresolvedFromSource: Whether hidden unboosted rollables without isSecret=true, currently RevengeSigil and Apotheosis, should be labeled Secret in the external calculator.
Whether calculator time estimates should include currency income constraints or only use mark opening rate once currency is available.
